subject: Next steps: Deployment path & compliance checklist for Medisys POC
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morris <dana.morris@medisys.co>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@medisys.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Deployment path & compliance checklist for Medisys POC

Team — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we have alignment on hosting options and the audit evidence you asked for during the call.

1) Primary constraint: Medisys requires a BAA and SOC2 Type II artifacts to move past legal + security review. You mentioned PHI will be present in the POC, so HIPAA controls will apply.

2) Deployment options we discussed (pros/cons at a glance):
   - Hosted API (fastest): lowest time-to-prod; we can enable data isolation features and regional routing, but this requires us to provide SOC2 artifacts and an approved BAA.
   - Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool): gives you predictable throughput + tenant isolation at the infra layer; Redwood signs a BAA and we provide dedicated metrics/tracing for audits.
   - Private (VPC / on-prem): required if your procurement/legal require customer-managed networking or air-gap. This path needs longer lead time for onboarding, KMS integration, and an environment review.

3) Immediate asks from Medisys security (so we can prioritize):
   - Confirm preferred deployment mode (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) — please indicate a primary and fallback.
   - Primary security contact for documentation exchange (name + email).
   - Target date for legal/security decision so we can schedule the right resources (SOC2 proof package & BAA review).

Attachments I uploaded for your team: SOC2-Type2-snapshot.pdf (summary of scope & testing window), BAA-draft-Medisys.docx (initial template), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (proposed milestones).

Proposed short MAP for POC (we can adjust):
 - Week 1: Sign NDA/BAA draft + designate security reviewer
 - Week 2: Delivery of SOC2 extracts, architecture diagram, encryption & data flow docs
 - Week 3: Test credentials + sandbox setup (Dedicated or Hosted)
 - Week 4: Run sample workloads + perf baseline; finalize procurement path

I'll loop in our SRE & Legal as soon as you confirm deployment preference and security contact. If Dedicated or Private is required, Karthik will coordinate on capacity and onboarding windows.

Thanks — looking forward to your decisions so we can lock timelines.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

Hi Grace — thanks for the very helpful recap. Quick answers from our side: we are leaning toward Dedicated capacity for the POC because our security team wants strong tenant isolation and predictable SLAs. Private VPC is our fallback if legal pushes for customer-managed networking, but that would add 4–6 weeks to the timeline.

Security contact: Mike Chen (mike.chen@medisys.co) — he'll handle the evidence intake.

Target decision date: we should have sign-off from security/legal by May 20th; procurement will follow.

Please confirm: will Dedicated provide the ability to export audit logs per-tenant and a KMS integration for keys? Also, can you provide the SOC2 artifact package by EOD tomorrow so I can forward to Mike?

Dana
Director, IT Security
Medisys Health

Dana — thanks, that timeline works. Quick answers and next actions: 

- Dedicated capabilities: yes — Dedicated includes per-tenant audit logging (we can deliver CloudTrail-style logs and request-level traces) and supports KMS integration (bring-your-own-key or Redwood-managed). I'll have Karthik confirm the exact log retention and KMS modes below.

- SOC2 package: attaching SOC2-Type2-snapshot.pdf — it's a redacted summary with control mappings and the testing window. The detailed evidence bundle (control mappings, vendor attestations) is available on request; we can export that directly to a shared Drive link or upload to your secure portal.

- BAA: attached is the initial BAA draft. Per process, Legal will review and propose edits. We'll prepare a DocuSign envelope for signature — link included in related links once Legal greenlights.

Next actions for Medisys (can you confirm by EOD May 14):
  1) Confirm Dedicated as primary and Private as fallback (reply: "Confirmed: Dedicated / fallback Private")
  2) Confirm security reviewer (you listed Mike; is that final?)
  3) Any geographic residency requirements beyond US (e.g., specific region or data center)?

I'll create the MAP ticket in HubSpot and route to Karthik for capacity scheduling. If you want a short 30-min SRE sync to walk logs/KMS before the MAP starts, we can set that up early next week.

Thanks,
Grace

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Deployment path & compliance checklist for Medisys POC

Dana / Grace — looping in a couple of technical confirmations from SRE side.

1) Logs & retention: Dedicated tenants get request-level traces and per-request metadata. Standard retention for exported logs is 90 days; we can extend retention to 1 year for compliance packages (we'll need to scope storage).

2) KMS options: we support two modes for Dedicated — Redwood-managed KMS with customer key control, or customer-managed keys via an external KMS (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) in a connected VPC. For Private installs we can also integrate HSMs but that requires the on-prem network handoff and firewall rules.

3) Onboarding ETA: If you confirm Dedicated by May 14, we can provision a dedicated pool and sandbox environment during the week of May 24 (2-week lead). Private VPC would push the first usable sandbox to mid-June.

4) Evidence handoff: Grace — I can package the per-tenant log export samples and an architect's diagram. Dana/Mike — tell me a secure upload method (shared Drive folder or your secure portal) and I'll drop the zipped evidence set.

If it helps, I can join your security call with Mike this Friday to walk the logs/KMS notes live.

-Karthik
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
